scenarios.description: Sign-in page with the one-time code form open and empty.
scenarios.target: The sign-in gate switches to "sign in with a one-time code"; nothing is typed into it.

scenarios.description: Providers page: the provider rail and the selected provider's model list.
scenarios.target: The relay provider is selected in the pinned rail; its two configured models are listed beside it.

scenarios.description: Model health check that passed and shows the model's reply.
scenarios.target: The Demo Model row was tested from the page and shows OK plus the reply text.

scenarios.description: Models page: the three role cards and the save bar.
scenarios.target: Agent, Vision and Tool Model cards, with the Agent thinking effort drafted and unsaved.

scenarios.description: Prompts page: the saved global persona and its applied version.
scenarios.target: The editor holds the seeded persona and shows the applied external version v1.

scenarios.description: Playground room where a persona answered a test scene.
scenarios.target: A held test scene was released and the scripted persona reply is in the timeline.

scenarios.description: Telegram page with no token configured.
scenarios.target: The token was cleared through the dialog: the page says no token is configured.

scenarios.description: Telegram page after saving the token, showing the connected bot.
scenarios.target: The token was saved through this form and the connection reports connected with @surowan_bot.

scenarios.description: Chats page with the allowed Chats.
scenarios.target: The allowlist lists the seeded private Chat and the docs group Chat with their titles, topic scope, agent model, policy summary and active state.

scenarios.description: Playground with Hold on and two pending messages.
scenarios.target: The room holds its input; the seeded message plus one typed here are pending, no run exists.

scenarios.description: Playground after a release: the reply and the completed run.
scenarios.target: Releasing the hold ran the bot: the reply is in the timeline and the run card is completed with an Audit link.

scenarios.description: Overview page with the expanded sidebar navigation.
scenarios.target: The dashboard renders real counters, the bot status and the full navigation rail.

scenarios.description: Keychain: entries and the config paths that reference them.
scenarios.target: Used entries name their config paths; one unused entry shows the orphan state.

scenarios.description: API keys page with keys in different permission modes.
scenarios.target: Three keys created through the dialog, one per permission mode, listed with their modes.

scenarios.description: Passkey management list with two registered keys.
scenarios.target: Two passkeys registered through the real WebAuthn ceremony, with the password state.

scenarios.description: Telegram page: the message-batch timing card after a save.
scenarios.target: The batch timing was saved through this card: a 60 s ceiling and a 5 s extension, no unsaved changes.

scenarios.description: Entry gate page with the global gate enabled in enforce mode.
scenarios.target: The gate was enabled and saved through the form; the behaviour card and the connection card with its keychain reference are in one frame.

scenarios.description: Harness tuning: the budget and send-protection sections.
scenarios.target: The budget card and the start of the send-behaviour card, with the section navigation on the left.

scenarios.description: Review draft with the export confirmation dialog open.
scenarios.target: A draft written on an invocation page, its goal and purpose filled in, and the Markdown export dialog.

scenarios.description: Failed tool session with the Resume action and the live-refresh switches.
scenarios.target: The newest run of its Conversation failed at the model call; Resume is offered and Auto refresh shows on.

scenarios.description: Active-hours dialog of a group Chat set to ask-only.
scenarios.target: Only /ask was chosen and saved for the group; the dialog shows the stored mode.

scenarios.description: Proactive-reply dialog of a group Chat with custom values.
scenarios.target: The group was given its own chance settings and saved; the dialog reads back the stored percentages.

scenarios.description: Per-Chat entry gate dialog with four overrides saved.
scenarios.target: Enabled, mode, threshold and question are set for the group, and the dialog shows the saved overrides.

scenarios.description: MCP-binding dialog of a group Chat with one bound server.
scenarios.target: Explicit bindings with the stdio fixture bound and narrowed to its echo tool.

scenarios.description: Memories: the edit dialog of an active memo.
scenarios.target: The seeded memo opens for editing with its summary, Markdown detail and lifetime.

scenarios.description: Group memory: the consolidation-progress panel of the seeded Chat.
scenarios.target: The lane shows its failed batch, the failed count and the messages still pending behind it.

scenarios.description: Group-memory dialog of a group Chat with the 30-hour clock chosen.
scenarios.target: Group memory is on, no overlap is selected and saved, and the dialog reads the choice back.

scenarios.description: Dictionary import dialog with a parsed CSV row.
scenarios.target: A pasted CSV is previewed with its split aliases; nothing is written before the confirm.

scenarios.description: Image settings page with generation enabled and a model configured.
scenarios.target: A taller frame holds the enable switch with its credential row and the saved model card, with nothing unsaved.

scenarios.description: Image generation workbench with an inline reference and a prompt asset.
scenarios.target: The editor holds a typed {{image:…}} token and the prompt asset is attached through its tag; the resolved prompt expands both.

scenarios.description: A completed image generation record with its output and reference image.
scenarios.target: A run that finished through the real worker: status, resolved prompt and the generated picture.

scenarios.description: Image assets: the reference-image tab with the Agent-visible toggle.
scenarios.target: An uploaded reference image with its name and the Agent-visible switch.

scenarios.description: Bot sticker sets: the configured set and its search index.
scenarios.target: The seeded mascot set with its sync state and the indexed sticker with its description.

scenarios.description: Web search settings with one configured engine.
scenarios.target: An engine added through the dialog with a note and a URL filter, saved and read back.

scenarios.description: Recurring alarms: the rule form and its next-run preview.
scenarios.target: A weekly alarm whose rules are filled in and whose preview lists the next five runs.

scenarios.description: MCP servers page with a ready server, a degraded one and progressive exposure.
scenarios.target: The stdio fixture connected with progressive exposure and skills, the HTTP endpoint degraded.

scenarios.description: Settings page where the file no longer matches the running configuration.
scenarios.target: A Chat edit that needs a restart is pending: the file hash differs and the pending path is listed.

scenarios.description: Warnings page with the standing MCP-unreachable warning.
scenarios.target: The degraded HTTP server produces a standing warning naming the affected aliases.

scenarios.description: Tool session detail: tool calls with their arguments and the Telegram send.
scenarios.target: The send row is expanded with its arguments and result, next to the read call and the run state.
